verdict.rationale: Agora's own introduction docs say coding agents can connect to an Agora MCP server alongside its CLI and Skills, so an official MCP server is claimed first-party. That claim is a single line, with no detail on setup, exposed tools, transport or authentication. missing for 10: MCP server setup/connection documentation, list of exposed tools/capabilities, auth and transport details, independent or hands-on corroboration that agents can connect.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Let your coding agent build with Agora. Connect the CLI, MCP server, and Skills to your AI workflow.
